name: Platypus sAVAX pool cash/liability accounting manipulation
summary: In the Platypus sAVAX/WAVAX pool a withdrawal reduced the asset's full liability even when cash was short, so flash-loaned deposits, a swap that drained one side, withdrawals and a reverse swap shifted the coverage ratios and slippage in the attacker's favour, returning more WAVAX and sAVAX than deposited.
notes: Only three transactions ever emitted deposit, swap and withdraw events from this pool together between its last upgrade and block 36700000: the attacker's first run, a copycat (0x464073f6) and the attacker's second run. Victims are the LP-WAVAX and LP-sAVAX asset contracts.
Separate incident from the February 2023 MasterPlatypusV4 emergencyWithdraw exploit: different contract and vulnerability.
